annotation.title_clean: Protocolo ante Contingencias de Indisponibilidad de los Servicios Informáticos del Poder Judicial de Santa Fe
annotation.title_en: Protocol for Contingencies of Unavailability of IT Services of the Judiciary of Santa Fe
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Corte Suprema de Justicia de la Provincia de Santa Fe
annotation.venue: Corte Suprema de Justicia de Santa Fe (Acuerdo, Acta N° 31)
annotation.summary_en: Resolution of the Santa Fe (Argentina) Supreme Court approving a protocol for continuity of judicial services during IT outages such as cyberattacks. It sets paper-based filing, manual registration, device shutdown and disconnection, and gradual restoration under Court authority. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Paper filings with handwritten signatures replace electronic submissions during outages
Courts manually register filings and later digitize them into SISFE
Users must power off and disconnect equipment from the network until the Court authorizes restart
Official email and website outages are handled via alternative channels
Supreme Court decides activation, duration and gradual restoration; training to be provided
